info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Prioritization API allows businesses to retrieve a list of support ticket priorities, facilitating effective management of customer inquiries. This endpoint provides essential information regarding the available priority levels that can be assigned to support tickets. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and support managers who require clarity on how to prioritize issues based on their severity and urgency. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their support workflow and ensure timely resolutions for critical customer issues.

get.summary: Retrieve the priority levels of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the available priority levels for tickets. This information can be utilized to help classify and manage tickets based on their urgency and importance.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving ticket priority information. This payload specifies the criteria for the priority query.

ListSupportTicketsPrioritysRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for fetching ticket priorities in the operations context. It is expected to be a string that provides details about the requested ticket priorities.
